name: Carol Castro
bio: Carolina "Carol" Osório de Castro (Rio de Janeiro, March 10, 1984) is a Brazilian actress. In 2019, she won the award for best supporting actress at the Gramado Film Festival, for her role as Madalena in the film Veneza.
